title: [CQ-V04] Frozen focused check dispatch
description:
Objective: Run required focused checks on each profile task candidate and publish pass only after integrity checks.

Deliverable: Frozen focused check dispatch. This is task V04 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): V03.
definitionOfDone: All required check definitions/environment match approval.
Exit0 followed by tree/index/HEAD mutation is not a passing trusted result.
Missing/skipped/inconclusive required checks cannot pass completion.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:
TESTS FIRST (red). Load test-driven-development.

These prerequisites must be in HEAD; adapt to their landed names (planningNotes lists the assumed ones) and never re-implement them:
- CQ-V03b: state/checkObservationStore.ts;
- CQ-V03: tools/recordCheckDispatch.ts and tools/recordCheckObservation.ts.

Create packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/requiredChecks.strong.test.ts (vitest). Keep it to about 230 lines, table-driven, because tests count toward QA's 400-net cap.

Readiness mock, scoped to this file:
- vi.mock('./executionProfile.js') spreads importOriginal and replaces only assertExecutionProfileReady with () => undefined.
- Pin production with vi.importActual: the real assertExecutionProfileReady('verified-local') still throws codeName EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY.

Fixture, in the style of delivery/requiredChecks.delivery.test.ts (ToolTestHarness, a temp git repo, submit_plan measuring the snapshot):
- settings executionProfile 'verified-local', deliveryPolicy 'local-branch', approvalMode 'TURBO' (so submit_plan auto-approves and approvedPlanRevision === planRevision), checkEnvironments [ENV_A];
- the approved defs acc (UNIT) and lint (LINT);
- a current candidate whose protectedEntries equal the snapshot, plus a completion commit.

Helpers dispatch(check, env) and observe(dispatchId, outcome, exitCode) call the V03 tool handlers with context { runner: { runnerId: 'runner-0123456789abcdef' } }. Assert exact codeNames, tokens, record fields and file absence; never truthiness.

Cases:
- A, admission (DoD 1). Each refusal writes no file under .moe/checks/dispatches:
  - an unowed command, or an owed command with a wrong or missing checkId: NOT_ALLOWED CHECK_DEFINITION_NOT_APPROVED;
  - ENV_B (unlisted), or no checkEnvironments at all: CHECK_ENVIRONMENT_NOT_APPROVED;
  - checkEnvironments 'x' (not an array): INVALID_INPUT field checkEnvironments.
  An identical replay of an already-recorded dispatch id, after ENV_A is removed, still returns duplicate:true.
- P, positive control: authenticated 'passed' runs for acc and lint in ENV_A give missingEvidence [].
- R, freshness (DoD 1 and 2). Starting from that passing pair, each of these brings back both required-check tokens:
  1. a re-approval at revision 2;
  2. ENV_A removed from checkEnvironments;
  3. a newer candidate with a different tree.
- D, diagnostic (DoD 2): a record_check_run run (recordCheckRunTool) with source runner-observed, exit 0, outcome passed, the same candidate, tree, command, planRevision and ENV_A, the channel's runnerId and a REAL dispatchId leaves the token under verified-local. The identical fixture under executionProfile 'legacy' counts it, as today.
- O, outcomes (DoD 2 and 3): it.each over no dispatch, dispatched but unobserved, skipped (exit 0), inconclusive (0), timeout (0), infra-failure (0) and code-failure (1) for acc. Each keeps required-check:UNIT, and a dependent of the DONE task stays withheld through dependencyShortfall / unmetDependsOn, the one shared predicate.
- U, undeclared: a verified-local task with no requiredChecks and no owed gate reports required-checks-undeclared. With qualityGate set and qualityGateScope everyTask, owedChecks is [{command: gate}] instead.
- T, twin ids: two approved defs with the same command each need their own dispatch, so a pass for one alone leaves the token.

Run `npx vitest run src/delivery/requiredChecks.strong.test.ts`: the new cases fail, and the readiness pin and the legacy case pass.

packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/recordCheckDispatch.ts was created by CQ-V03. It is listed as new only because it does not exist at plan time: edit it, never recreate it.

After the runner-channel gate and the unknown-key check, and before delegating to the store's recordCheckDispatch:
- skip admission when params.id names a dispatch that is already recorded (getCheckDispatch), so a crash retry still replays under the store's rules;
- otherwise call assertCheckDispatchApproved(state, params), so an unapproved dispatch writes nothing.
Add the two codeNames to the tool description. Nothing else changes. Admission and the store write happen in the same non-blocking tool call, under the state mutex.

reopenReason: Unblocked on the human's explicit, repeated instruction ("unblock tasks", then "unblock", 2026-10-27). Plan now instead of parking. Use prerequisites' landed code or approved plans where they exist. Otherwise use their task description, DoD and docs/plans/2026-10-24-ai-code-quality-and-context.md. Name every assumed interface in planningNotes. Keep dependsOn, so WORKING waits until the prerequisites are DONE. If a prerequisite's contract must be designed first, split it out (SPIDR, as with R10a) instead of report_blocked. Re-block only if any possible plan would breach a rail.

comments.content:
Planning note from architect-e4b7eee0, 2026-10-29, for whoever plans V04. V03 is now split, and all three slices are planned (WORKING):
- V03a (task-3b4e3833): a loopback-only `/runner` WebSocket path, authenticated by a host-only key at runnerKeyPath(projectPath) in ~/.moe/runner-keys. ToolCallContext.runner carries {runnerId}.
- V03b (task-c9fe2515): the dispatch records now live HERE, not in V04, as recordCheckDispatch and recordCheckObservation in state/checkObservationStore.ts. isAuthenticatedCheckRun(state, run) is the trust predicate V04 should wire into delivery policy for strict tasks. Do not create a second dispatch store.
- V03 (task-9cc13170): the runner-only tools moe.record_check_dispatch and moe.record_check_observation.
- V05 (task-6be626cf) is a pure decideRepair/resolveRepairPolicy module. Feed it one required check's runs (authenticated only, for strict tasks); acting on its decision is V12's job unless V04 exposes a seam.
- A dispatched command inherits CheckRun's 500-character cap.
See Serena mem:decision-cq-v03-split.

priorBlockedReason:
A plan written now would be speculative. CQ-V04 dispatches required focused checks through the isolated check runner and publishes a pass only through the authenticated observation channel, and neither exists yet.
1. The runner is CQ-R11 (BACKLOG, unplanned). It owns the fresh check environment, the environment identity that DoD1 must match against approval, and the post-run tree/index/HEAD re-measurement that DoD2 relies on.
2. The trusted-pass channel is CQ-V03 (BLOCKED, for the same reason, on CQ-V02 and CQ-R11).
CQ-V02 is planned (2026-10-26). It adds CheckRun outcome / planRevision / environment / dispatchId / attemptId, and a passedOn guard so skipped or inconclusive outcomes never count. That already covers most of DoD3. The planning analysis is in Serena memory task-<this id>-handoff. The task auto-unblocks to PLANNING when both prerequisites are DONE.

executionContract.intendedBehavior:
For a verified-local task, a required check passes only on trusted, approved evidence. Legacy and observe tasks are unchanged.
- owedChecks(state, task) in delivery/policy.ts is the frozen list a task owes on its current candidate: each approved protected definition {checkId, trimmed command}, only while readRequiredCheckSnapshot binds the snapshot to the current definitions, then the owed qualityGate {command} unless a definition already runs it.
- moe.record_check_dispatch admits a NEW dispatch only for an owed check (exact checkId and command), in an environment listed in settings.checkEnvironments. Otherwise it refuses NOT_ALLOWED CHECK_DEFINITION_NOT_APPROVED or CHECK_ENVIRONMENT_NOT_APPROVED and writes nothing. A replay of a recorded dispatch id skips admission.
- Under verified-local, an owed check counts only through a run on the current candidate's tree that is all of: authenticated (isAuthenticatedCheckRun); outcome exactly 'passed' with exit 0; planRevision equal to the task's current approved revision; bound to a dispatch naming that check; in an environment in settings.checkEnvironments, read live. Anything else, including every moe.record_check_run report, leaves required-check:<command>.
- A verified-local task that declares no requiredChecks and owes no gate reports required-checks-undeclared.
- settings.checkEnvironments is a project.json-only list of approved environment ids. Absent approves none; a malformed value is INVALID_INPUT wherever it is judged.
acceptanceCriteria: Dispatch admission refuses each of these by name and writes no file under .moe/checks: an unowed command, a wrong checkId, an unlisted environment, an absent environment list. A malformed checkEnvironments is INVALID_INPUT. An identical replay of a recorded dispatch still returns duplicate:true.

Under verified-local (readiness mocked in the new test file only), a required check passes only with an authenticated 'passed' run at the current approved revision, for that check's dispatch, in a listed environment. A revision change, a removed environment id or a newer candidate each brings required-check:<command> back.

Under verified-local, neither of these passes: exit 0 with outcome inconclusive, or a moe.record_check_run report carrying runner-observed, exit 0, outcome passed and a copied runnerId, dispatchId and binding.

Missing (no dispatch, or dispatched but unobserved), skipped, inconclusive, timeout, infra-failure and code-failure all leave the token, and evaluateDeliveryEvidence and the dependency projection agree.
The same fixture under legacy/observe keeps today's verdicts, and production readiness still throws EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY.
In a fresh Linux snapshot, `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` and `npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0, and numstat over packages/ is at most 400 net.
invariants: Legacy and observe tasks: every existing passedOn, checkShortfall and protectedCheckShortfall verdict is unchanged. The strong branch is reached only when resolveTaskExecutionProfile(...) === 'verified-local'.
assertExecutionProfileReady stays unconditional in production; only the new test file mocks it.
One predicate: qa_approve, dependency readiness and the projections all judge through evaluateDeliveryEvidence. There is no second rule.
Trust comes only from stored records (isAuthenticatedCheckRun, getCheckDispatch), never from arguments.
Admission runs in the same non-blocking, mutex-held tool call as the store write, and every refusal precedes the first write.
compatibility: The token vocabulary is unchanged except the new 'required-checks-undeclared', which applies to verified-local only.
record_check_dispatch keeps CQ-V03's params, result shape and replay rules. record_check_run, checkRunStore.ts and checkObservationStore.ts are not modified.
settings.checkEnvironments follows the deliveryPolicy precedent: set in .moe/project.json, refused as unknown by UPDATE_SETTINGS, and preserved by its {...project.settings} copy.
approvedScope: delivery/policy.ts: the exported OwedCheck, owedChecks, approvedCheckEnvironments and assertCheckDispatchApproved; the internal trustedPassedOn and owedGate; EVIDENCE_TOKENS.requiredChecksUndeclared and its reason.
tools/recordCheckDispatch.ts (created by CQ-V03): one admission call before delegating.
reuse: isAuthenticatedCheckRun and getCheckDispatch (CQ-V03b, state/checkObservationStore.ts) are the only trust source.
readRequiredCheckSnapshot, validateExecutionContract, requiredCheckCommand, listCandidatesForTask, listCheckRunsForCandidate and resolveTaskExecutionProfile are already among policy.ts's imports.
hasControlChar (state/candidateStore.ts) implements the environment-id rule, matching checkRunStore's private readEnvironment: non-blank, at most 255 characters, no C0 or DEL.
The fixture style of delivery/requiredChecks.delivery.test.ts: ToolTestHarness, a temp git repo, submit_plan measuring the snapshot.
sourceAssumptions: packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/policy.ts: passedOn(state, current, command) is the one pass rule. checkShortfall (via hasPassingCheck) and protectedCheckShortfall call it. evaluateDeliveryEvidence first calls resolveTaskDeliveryPolicy, which throws EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY for verified-local.
packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/executionProfile.ts: resolveTaskExecutionProfile(settings, snapshot) floors to a stored verified-local snapshot, and assertExecutionProfileReady is unconditional.
packages/moe-daemon/src/state/validators.ts: validateSettingsUpdate's allowlist omits deliveryPolicy and starts from {...project.settings}, so a project.json-only key survives settings updates.
packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/toolTestHarness.ts defaults approvalMode to CONTROL. TURBO makes submit_plan auto-approve (PLAN_AUTO_APPROVED, approvedPlanRevision).

ASSUMED, from CQ-V03b's approved plan (unlanded): state/checkObservationStore.ts exports isAuthenticatedCheckRun(state, run): boolean (stored run plus marker plus dispatch; never throws) and getCheckDispatch(state, id): CheckDispatch | null. CheckDispatch is {id, taskId, candidateId, treeSha, planRevision, command, checkId?, environment, runnerId, createdAt}.

ASSUMED, from CQ-V03's approved plan (unlanded): tools/recordCheckDispatch.ts exports recordCheckDispatchTool(state). Its handler(args, state, context) refuses without context.runner (RUNNER_CHANNEL_REQUIRED), rejects unknown keys, then delegates to recordCheckDispatch(state, context.runner, params). recordCheckObservationTool takes {id, dispatchId, exitCode, outcome, outputTail?, environment}.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Scope, decided by the human in the REPL on 2026-10-29: 'Daemon core, split rest'.
- V04 keeps the daemon core: the frozen owed-check list, dispatch admission and the strong pass rule.
- CQ-V04b (task-340a07b3) is the local-runner dispatch client, after R11 final.
- CQ-V04c (task-c4e076cd) is the honest host-gate outcome, after V08 and the other wrapper editors.
- V12 depends on both.

The approved environment, also the human's choice ('Human allowlist setting'): settings.checkEnvironments. Rejected:
- runner-pinned only: no real approval;
- capture at plan approval: a snapshot schema change, and every image change would force a replan.
Settings plumbing follows the deliveryPolicy precedent: project.json-only, judged where read, with no validators.ts change.

Where admission lives:
- In the tool (tools/recordCheckDispatch.ts), not in V03b's store. A store import of policy.ts would close a cycle, because policy.ts now imports checkObservationStore.
- It is skipped for an already-recorded dispatch id, which keeps V03b's crash-retry replay.

Environment approval is judged LIVE at evaluation as well as at dispatch, so a human can revoke a compromised image. The alternative, approval only at dispatch, could never revoke anything.

No runner read tool in V04: it would exceed QA's 400-net cap. V04b sources owedChecks through a new tool or get_context, and its planner decides.

Under verified-local the legacy no-outcome rule is dropped: an explicit 'passed' is required. A strong task with no checks reports required-checks-undeclared, which comes from CQ-04's acceptance that every task in the profile has appropriate required checks.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- policy.ts is the one predicate. qa_approve, dependency readiness and the projections all call evaluateDeliveryEvidence, so changing passedOn's callers changes every consumer consistently.
- resolveTaskDeliveryPolicy throws EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY for verified-local, so the strong branch is unreachable in production until certification. The new test file mocks the readiness assertion locally and pins the real one with vi.importActual.
- protectedCheckShortfall dedupes owed commands and reads definitions only through the validated contract plus readRequiredCheckSnapshot. Keep the legacy expressions unchanged and add the strong branch beside them.
- checkShortfall resolves the gate as live until DONE, then requiredCheckAtDone, with unreadable becoming a token. The owedGate extraction must keep exactly that.
- Fixtures: requiredChecks.delivery.test.ts builds candidates and runs directly on h.state maps. ToolTestHarness defaults approvalMode to CONTROL, so set TURBO for approvedPlanRevision.
- ASSUMED names from the prerequisites' approved plans (unlanded; adapt to what lands and note the difference):
  - CQ-V03b: isAuthenticatedCheckRun(state, run), getCheckDispatch(state, id), state.checkDispatches and state.checkObservations;
  - CQ-V03: recordCheckDispatchTool and recordCheckObservationTool, handler(args, state, { runner });
  - CQ-V02 (landed): CheckRun.outcome, planRevision, environment and dispatchId.
planningNotes.risks:
- Size: QA rejects past 400 net over packages/, and tests count. Keep the implementation to about 120 lines and the test to about 230, using it.each tables and shared helpers.
- Legacy drift: any change visible to legacy or observe tasks breaks the epic rail. Mutant 8 and the legacy case guard it.
- Revocation is live: removing an environment id un-satisfies DONE strong tasks and withholds their dependents until re-checked. This is intended, and documented in the schema comment and MCP_SERVER.md.
- The prerequisite files must be in HEAD before WORKING (dependsOn V03, which covers V03a, V03b, R11 and the others). tools/recordCheckDispatch.ts is in newFiles only because it does not exist at plan time; edit it.
- schema.ts and MCP_SERVER.md are shared. Preserve peers' bytes; overlapping editors are serialized through the V03 chain.
- verified-local stays unavailable. Never change assertExecutionProfileReady.
- Docs debt (CONFIGURATION.md, SCHEMA.md) and the activation gap (nothing invokes the V04b client per candidate yet) are recorded on V12 (task-b621ddc9).
